records.primary_outcome: Cannabis withdrawal severity, Cannabis Withdrawal Scale (19-item, 0-10 per item), during the 6-day treatment
records.primary_outcome_source: Methods: The primary outcome measure was the Cannabis Withdrawal Scale (CWS).
records.anchor_as_printed: Nabiximols treatment significantly reduced the overall severity of cannabis withdrawal relative to placebo (F8,377.97 = 2.39; P = .01), including effects on withdrawal-related irritability, depression, and cannabis cravings
records.notes: n = 51 inpatients; ANZCTR registration, no NCT; abstract gives an F test only, no effect size; first psychiatry trial in the set; JAMA Psychiatry PDF via Zaid JAMA login
